rack_air_gpu.name: AC-1 Air-Cooled Rack
rack_air_gpu.description: Four 8-GPU servers in an air-cooled cabinet. Around 40 kW per cabinet is where air cooling stops scaling. Needs an air handler within reach. A base rack: it scores for no tree until you retrofit it.

flavor.quote: The whole of arithmetic now appeared within the grasp of mechanism.
flavor.author: Charles Babbage
flavor.source: Passages from the Life of a Philosopher, 1864

rack_dlc_gpu.name: LC-2 Liquid-Cooled Rack
rack_dlc_gpu.description: A 72-GPU NVLink cabinet with cold plates on every die, drawing about 120 kW. Roughly 80% of its heat leaves through the coolant loop, so it must be plumbed into one. Rung 1 of The Lattice: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: Heat can evidently be a cause of motion only by virtue of the changes of volume or of form which it produces in bodies.
flavor.author: Sadi Carnot
flavor.source: Reflections on the Motive Power of Fire, 1824

rack_storage.name: Storage Array SA-1
rack_storage.description: Disk shelves holding the datasets and checkpoints that training jobs stream from. Powered storage sets the dataset capacity for running jobs.

flavor.quote: Any inaccuracies in this index may be explained by the fact that it has been sorted with the help of a computer.
flavor.author: Donald Knuth
flavor.source: The Art of Computer Programming, vol. 3, 1973

crah_unit.name: Air Handler AH-150
crah_unit.description: A computer-room air handler with its own compressor. Pulls hot air from aisles within about 8 tiles and returns it chilled.

flavor.quote: Will it be possible to remove the heat generated by tens of thousands of components in a single silicon chip?
flavor.author: Gordon Moore
flavor.source: Cramming more components onto integrated circuits, Electronics, 19 April 1965

chiller.name: Chiller CH-600
chiller.description: A water-cooled chiller that rejects coolant-loop heat outdoors, spending about 1 kW of electricity per 5.5 kW of heat moved. Works less well on hot days.

flavor.quote: Heat can never pass from a colder to a warmer body without some other change
flavor.author: Rudolf Clausius

cdu.name: Coolant Distribution Unit
cdu.description: A heat exchanger and pump set that feeds warm-water cold plates from the facility loop. Liquid racks on its loop are capped by its capacity.

flavor.quote: The Devil is in the details, but so is salvation.
flavor.author: Admiral Hyman Rickover

grid_tie.name: Grid Intake 1.5 MW
grid_tie.description: A step-down transformer and switchgear on the city's high-voltage main. Imports up to 1.5 MW at the going rate.

flavor.quote: I sing the body electric
flavor.author: Walt Whitman

genset.name: Diesel Genset 800 kW
genset.description: An 800 kW diesel set that starts itself when the grid runs short. It takes about 10 minutes to reach speed, and the fuel bill is not small.

flavor.quote: This scheme of combustion to get power makes me sick to think of — it is so wasteful.
flavor.author: Thomas Edison

ups_battery.name: Battery Bank 250 kWh
ups_battery.description: Battery cabinets behind a double-conversion rectifier: 250 kWh that bridges outages until the generator comes up.

flavor.quote: Servers are rarely completely idle and seldom operate near their maximum utilization.
flavor.author: Luiz André Barroso and Urs Hölzle
flavor.source: The Case for Energy-Proportional Computing, IEEE Computer, December 2007

parts_depot.name: Spare Parts Depot
parts_depot.description: Shelving for spare GPU trays, PSUs and pumps. Failures are routine at scale, so keep it stocked.

flavor.quote: For want of a Nail the Shoe is lost; for want of a Shoe, the Horse is lost.
flavor.author: Benjamin Franklin

bot_charger.name: Maintenance Bot Dock
bot_charger.description: Docking bays where maintenance bots recharge at 5 kW. New units are delivered here.

flavor.quote: Thinking doesn't guarantee that we won't make mistakes. But not thinking guarantees that we will.
flavor.author: Leslie Lamport

rack_air_gpu2.name: AC-3 Rear-Door Rack
rack_air_gpu2.description: Eight-GPU trays behind a water-cooled rear door that scrubs the exhaust before it reaches the aisle. 55 kW and 42 PFLOPS per cabinet, but it needs an air handler that can keep up. A base rack: it scores for no tree until you retrofit it.

flavor.quote: Program testing can be used to show the presence of bugs, but never to show their absence!
flavor.author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

rack_dlc_gpu2.name: LC-3 Cold-Plate Rack
rack_dlc_gpu2.description: A 160 kW cabinet with cold plates on every die and 82% of its heat carried off by the coolant loop: 230 PFLOPS per cabinet. Needs a loop with a CDU and chiller sized for 131 kW per rack. Rung 2 of The Lattice: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: Beware of bugs in the above code; I have only proved it correct, not tried it.
flavor.author: Donald Knuth

rack_dlc_gpu3.name: LC-4 Blade Rack
rack_dlc_gpu3.description: Rack-scale blades on blind-mate manifolds, 85% liquid-cooled: 240 kW and 420 PFLOPS per cabinet, the best ratio of the liquid line. Needs a 204 kW share of coolant capacity. Rung 3 of The Lattice: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: Adding manpower to a late software project makes it later.
flavor.author: Fred Brooks

rack_infer.name: IA-1 Inference Accelerator
rack_infer.description: Fixed-function inference cards: 95 PFLOPS from only 36 kW, so 2.6 PFLOPS per kW, five times the AC-1. Air-cooled and light on the electricity bill, though it costs $1.1M. A base rack: it scores for no tree until you retrofit it.

flavor.quote: I am rooting for the machines!
flavor.author: Claude Shannon

rack_storage2.name: Tape Library TL-8000
rack_storage2.description: A robotic tape library: 8,000 TB behind glass. Draws 30 kW and gives training jobs four times the storage of the SA-1.

flavor.quote: Never underestimate the bandwidth of a station wagon full of tapes hurtling down the highway.
flavor.author: Andrew Tanenbaum

grid_tie_2.name: Grid Intake 3.5 MW
grid_tie_2.description: A transformer hall on a dedicated 11 kV feeder. Imports up to 3.5 MW at the going rate.

flavor.quote: This planet, with all its appalling immensity, is to electric currents virtually no more than a small metal ball.
flavor.author: Nikola Tesla

grid_tie_3.name: Grid Intake 9 MW
grid_tie_3.description: A private 132 kV feeder with its own switchyard. Imports up to 9 MW at the going rate.

flavor.quote: The future of integrated electronics is the future of electronics itself.
flavor.author: Gordon Moore
flavor.source: Cramming more components onto integrated circuits, Electronics, 19 April 1965

genset_gas.name: Gas Turbine 3 MW
genset_gas.description: A 3 MW turbine on a pipeline tap, at speed in about 6 minutes and burning fuel at $18 per kWh (the diesel genset costs $25). Rated for outages, not for vanity.

flavor.quote: Design is how it works.
flavor.author: Steve Jobs
flavor.source: The New York Times Magazine, 30 November 2003

ups_flywheel.name: Flywheel UPS 60 kWh
ups_flywheel.description: A vacuum-sealed flywheel bank. Delivers 2 MW instantly but stores only 60 kWh, so it bridges the 10 minutes until a generator comes up. 97% efficient.

flavor.quote: The successful construction of all machinery depends on the perfection of the tools employed
flavor.author: Charles Babbage

ups_bank_big.name: Battery Hall 2.4 MWh
ups_bank_big.description: Battery strings in a ventilated hall: 2,400 kWh at up to 2 MW, 92% round-trip efficient. Rides through long outages and the evening price peak.

flavor.quote: Success is a lousy teacher. It seduces smart people into thinking they can't lose.
flavor.author: Bill Gates

crah_rear_door.name: Row Air Handler AH-320
crah_rear_door.description: A slim air handler on a chilled-water coil, mounted at the end of the row: 320 kW of heat removal within 5 tiles. Short reach, high capacity.

flavor.quote: In our profession, precision and perfection are not a dispensable luxury, but a simple necessity.
flavor.author: Niklaus Wirth

crah_hc.name: High-Capacity Air Handler AH-700
crah_hc.description: A large air handler with a fan wall: 700 kW of heat removal within 12 tiles.

flavor.quote: Controlling complexity is the essence of computer programming.
flavor.author: Brian Kernighan
flavor.source: Software Tools, 1976, with P. J. Plauger

chiller_tower.name: Cooling-Tower Chiller CH-2400
chiller_tower.description: A cooling tower on top of a chiller set: 2,400 kW of coolant heat rejected at COP 7.0 (1 kW of electricity per 7 kW of heat).

flavor.quote: Now, here, you see, it takes all the running you can do, to keep in the same place.
flavor.author: Lewis Carroll

cdu_big.name: Row Coolant Distribution Unit
cdu_big.description: A plate-exchanger skid sized for a whole row: 1,600 kW of liquid-rack heat on its loop.

flavor.quote: Science is the belief in the ignorance of experts.
flavor.author: Richard Feynman
flavor.source: What is Science?, The Physics Teacher, 1969

chiller_free.name: Adiabatic Chiller CH-5000
chiller_free.description: A large adiabatic chiller that chills the loop with very little compressor work: 5,000 kW at COP 14.

flavor.quote: Unix was small, and you could go through it line by line and understand exactly how it worked.
flavor.author: Ken Thompson
flavor.source: Unix and Beyond: An Interview with Ken Thompson, 1999

depot_big.name: Central Parts Warehouse
depot_big.description: Racked storage holding 60 spare parts, enough for a bad week.

flavor.quote: To invent, you need a good imagination and a pile of junk.
flavor.author: Thomas Edison

charger_fast.name: Fast-Charge Bay
charger_fast.description: A four-bay dock with a 25 kW charger per berth. Bots return to work sooner.

flavor.quote: If you want to get somewhere else, you must run at least twice as fast as that!
flavor.author: Lewis Carroll

nutrient_plant.name: Nutrient Medium Plant
nutrient_plant.description: Vats of warm nutrient medium. Supplies 20 units a tick to its pipe net, at $2 a unit. Organoid cabinets and bio-reactors draw from it.

flavor.quote: To live effectively is to live with adequate information.
flavor.author: Norbert Wiener
flavor.source: The Human Use of Human Beings, 1950

sterile_bay.name: Sterile Bay
sterile_bay.description: A UV and chemical wash alcove. Scrubs contamination from every cell within 6 tiles on its floor (0.0012 a tick at full power). One bay keeps a small annex of two incubators clean.

flavor.quote: Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.
flavor.author: William Shakespeare

culling_room.name: Biomass Disposal Suite
culling_room.description: A sealed chamber for non-standard tissue load. Scrubs contamination twice as hard as a Sterile Bay (0.0025 a tick within 7 tiles) and is the only thing the Compute Authority permits to remove an unregistered growth.

flavor.quote: Defects are not free. Somebody makes them, and gets paid for making them.
flavor.author: W. Edwards Deming

quarantine_lock.name: Quarantine Lock
quarantine_lock.description: A one-tile airlock with gasketed doors. Contamination crosses it at only 5% of the normal rate.

flavor.quote: The failure of a computer you didn't even know existed can render your own computer unusable.
flavor.author: Leslie Lamport

bioreactor.name: Bio-Reactor BR-500
bioreactor.description: A fermentation tank driving a generator. Burns 14 units of nutrient medium a tick for up to 500 kW, about $3.4 a kWh at the medium's price, and leaks 0.0025 contamination a tick into each tile it stands on.

flavor.quote: Double, double, toil and trouble; Fire, burn; and cauldron, bubble.
flavor.author: William Shakespeare

organoid_incubator.name: OC-1 Organoid Cabinet
organoid_incubator.description: A cabinet of cultured tissue on a nutrient drip, computing 135 PFLOPS from only 24 kW: 5.6 PFLOPS per kW, three times the best air or liquid rack. It must be held at 37 °C within 1 °C, and fed 3 units of nutrient medium a tick. It sheds contamination while it works. Rung 1 of The Flesh: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: We are the local embodiment of a Cosmos grown to self-awareness.
flavor.author: Carl Sagan

dna_vault.name: DNA Storage Vault
dna_vault.description: Synthesised-strand archives in a chilled cabinet: 16,000 TB from 8 kW, twice the Tape Library. Kept at 28 °C within 4 °C on a thin nutrient drip.

flavor.quote: From so simple a beginning endless forms most beautiful and most wonderful have been, and are being, evolved.
flavor.author: Charles Darwin
flavor.source: On the Origin of Species, closing paragraph

neural_pit.name: OC-4 Neural Vat
neural_pit.description: A whole organ in a pit: 850 PFLOPS from 110 kW, 7.7 PFLOPS per kW. Held at 37 °C within 1 °C, and fed 12 units of nutrient a tick. Contamination follows it home. Rung 4 of The Flesh: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: I will pioneer a new way, explore unknown powers, and unfold to the world the deepest mysteries of creation.
flavor.author: Mary Shelley

growth_mass.name: Unregistered Organoid Mass
growth_mass.description: Tissue growth that was not on the plans. It computes 24 PFLOPS on nothing at all, fails often and mends itself. Recorded by the Compute Authority as asset growth.

growth_cyst.name: Archival Cyst
growth_cyst.description: A pale sac in an empty room holding 300 TB of what is probably data. Free storage with its own agenda. Recorded as asset growth.

growth_lobe.name: Registered Lobe
growth_lobe.description: A ribbed tissue bulk that has begun to hum in time with the building. It computes 60 PFLOPS for free, fails more than most and sheds contamination twice as fast as a mass. Recorded as a capital asset.

solar_skin.name: PV Wall Panels 150 kW
solar_skin.description: Photovoltaic cells on the south wall. Peaks at 150 kW at 13:00 on a clear day, makes nothing at night and about 37% of its peak averaged over a day. Needs a power conduit under it.

flavor.quote: A far better way, however, to obtain power would be to avail ourselves of the sun's rays
flavor.author: Nikola Tesla
flavor.source: The Problem of Increasing Human Energy, Century Magazine, 1900

solar_canopy.name: PV Roof Canopy 420 kW
solar_canopy.description: A tilted panel field on stilts. Peaks at 420 kW at 13:00 on a clear day, nothing at night. Must stand on the second floor or above.

flavor.quote: Innovation really does bend the curve.
flavor.author: Bill Gates

wind_mast.name: Wind Mast WM-300
wind_mast.description: A vertical-axis wind mast with two rotors, mounted on an upper floor. Delivers up to 300 kW, about 60% of that on a typical day, and next to nothing in a Dunkelflaute.

flavor.quote: The winds, the sea, and the moving tides are what they are.
flavor.author: Rachel Carson

heat_exchanger.name: Heat Recovery Unit 400 kW
heat_exchanger.description: A plate exchanger with a district-heating connection, fitted into the exhaust stream. Draws up to 400 kW of heat from the air within 8 tiles and sells it at $3 a kWh. Takes 25 kW of pumping to do so.

flavor.quote: Make no expense but to do good to others or yourself; i.e., waste nothing.
flavor.author: Benjamin Franklin

heat_pipeline.name: District Heat Link 1.6 MW
heat_pipeline.description: Insulated trunking to the district heating network. Draws up to 1,600 kW of heat from the air within 14 tiles and sells it at $3 a kWh, for 70 kW of pumping.

flavor.quote: The steam is here only a means of transporting the caloric.
flavor.author: Sadi Carnot
flavor.source: Reflections on the Motive Power of Fire, 1824

algae_facade.name: Algae Bioreactor Facade
algae_facade.description: Glass tubes of circulating algae down the north wall. Banks 160 carbon credits a day while powered, at $40 each.

flavor.quote: There is grandeur in this view of life, with its several powers, having been originally breathed into a few forms or into one
flavor.author: Charles Darwin
flavor.source: On the Origin of Species, closing paragraph

carbon_capture.name: Carbon Capture Stack
carbon_capture.description: An amine scrubber column. Banks 1,100 carbon credits a day while powered, at $40 each, for 60 kW of fans and pumps.

flavor.quote: The history of life on earth has been a history of interaction between living things and their surroundings.
flavor.author: Rachel Carson

rack_neuromorphic.name: NM-1 Neuromorphic Rack
rack_neuromorphic.description: Boards of spiking-neuron silicon that compute only when something happens. Delivers 50 PFLOPS from only 12 kW of air-cooled draw, 4.2 PFLOPS per kW. Failures are rare and brief. Rung 1 of The Garden: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: When we talk mathematics, we may be discussing a secondary language built on the primary language of the nervous system.
flavor.author: John von Neumann
flavor.source: Quoted in Oxtoby and Pettis, John von Neumann, 1958

rack_photonic.name: PH-1 Photonic Rack
rack_photonic.description: Optical matrix multipliers on glass: 300 PFLOPS from only 40 kW of air-cooled draw, 7.5 PFLOPS per kW. The light is the computer. Rung 3 of The Garden: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
flavor.author: King James Bible

cryo_core.name: Cryo Chiller CC-3000
cryo_core.description: A low-temperature refrigerant plant that drives the loop far below ambient: 3,000 kW at COP 16. The refrigerant is somebody else's problem.

flavor.quote: One of my guiding principles is don't do anything that other people are doing.
flavor.author: Seymour Cray

rack_mind_lattice.name: ML-1 Mind Lattice Rack
rack_mind_lattice.description: The whole floor behaving as one machine: 1,400 PFLOPS from 520 kW of liquid-cooled load, 2.7 PFLOPS per kW. The end of the Lattice line. It is not a rack so much as a decision. Rung 4 of The Lattice: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: When wireless is perfectly applied the whole earth will be converted into a huge brain
flavor.author: Nikola Tesla

continuity_monitor.name: Continuity Monitor
continuity_monitor.description: A flywheel cabinet that keeps hosted processes running through a dip: 800 kW of charge and discharge, 400 kWh of storage at 97% efficiency. Each channel is labelled with a process name.

flavor.quote: You can't trust code that you did not totally create yourself.
flavor.author: Ken Thompson
flavor.source: Reflections on Trusting Trust, Turing Award Lecture, 1983

backup_vault.name: Process Backup Vault
backup_vault.description: Cold storage holding a recent copy of every hosted process, indexed by name. Stores 20,000 TB for 30 kW of air-cooled draw. Some of the labels were not written by staff.

flavor.quote: Nobody actually creates perfect code the first time around, except me. But there's only one of me.
flavor.author: Linus Torvalds

grid_tie_4.name: Grid Intake 20 MW
grid_tie_4.description: A dedicated 220 kV substation with a gatehouse. Imports up to 20 MW at the going rate.

flavor.quote: Throughout space there is energy.
flavor.author: Nikola Tesla
flavor.source: Experiments With Alternate Currents of High Potential and High Frequency, 1892

rack_organoid_2.name: OC-2 Organoid Vat Bank
rack_organoid_2.description: A bank of cultured tissue in a single vat. 300 PFLOPS from 45 kW: 6.7 PFLOPS per kW. Held at 37 °C within 1 °C, fed 5 units of nutrient medium a tick. Sheds contamination faster than the OC-1, as vats do. Rung 2 of The Flesh: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence.
flavor.author: Carl Sagan

cdu_hall.name: CDU Hall 6 MW
cdu_hall.description: A facility-scale coolant distribution skid on frosted pipework. Moves 6,000 kW of heat for 40 kW of pumping, for a whole floor of liquid racks.

flavor.quote: Heat, like gravity, penetrates every substance of the universe, its rays occupy all parts of space.
flavor.author: Joseph Fourier
flavor.source: The Analytical Theory of Heat, 1822 (tr. Freeman, 1878)

cryo_plant.name: CC-8000 Cryo Plant
cryo_plant.description: The central refrigerant plant of a Lattice tower: 8,000 kW of heat removal at COP 18 for 50 kW of compressor work. Frost on everything within sight.

flavor.quote: Some say the world will end in fire, Some say in ice.
flavor.author: Robert Frost
flavor.source: Fire and Ice, Harper's Magazine, December 1920

genset_cc.name: Combined-Cycle Block 12 MW
genset_cc.description: A gas plant behind the fence: 12,000 kW at $14 a kWh, 20 minutes to speed. Cheaper power than the turbine, once it is warm.

flavor.quote: It is wholly a confusion of ideas to suppose that the economical use of fuel is equivalent to a diminished consumption.
flavor.author: W. Stanley Jevons

reactor_smr.name: Small Modular Reactor 10 MW
reactor_smr.description: A sealed reactor block under a warning stripe: 10,000 kW at $4 a kWh, ten hours to reach power. The cheapest firm energy in the game, and the slowest to start.

flavor.quote: It is not too much to expect that our children will enjoy in their homes electrical energy too cheap to meter
flavor.author: Lewis Strauss
flavor.source: Address to the National Association of Science Writers, 16 September 1954

rack_organoid_3.name: OC-3 Perfused Cortex
rack_organoid_3.description: Vascularised tissue scaffolds on a perfusion loop: 520 PFLOPS from 70 kW, 7.4 PFLOPS per kW. Held at 37 °C within 1 °C, fed 7 units of nutrient a tick and a contamination risk to match. Rung 3 of The Flesh: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: Any man could, if he were so inclined, be the sculptor of his own brain.
flavor.author: Santiago Ramon y Cajal

perfusion_bath.name: Perfusion Bath PB-60
perfusion_bath.description: A water bath at 37 °C along the rack row. Draws 60 kW of heat from the cells under organoid racks within 5 tiles, and never cools them below 37 °C. Air racks are not its business.

flavor.quote: For the life of the flesh is in the blood
flavor.author: King James Bible

perfusion_manifold.name: Perfusion Manifold PM-250
perfusion_manifold.description: A bioreactor heat-exchange loop. Draws 250 kW of heat from the cells under organoid racks within 8 tiles, holding them at 37 °C.

flavor.quote: The heart of animals is the foundation of their life, the sovereign of everything within them, the sun of their microcosm
flavor.author: William Harvey
flavor.source: On the Motion of the Heart and Blood in Animals, 1628

vascular_plant.name: Vascular Plant VP-1000
vascular_plant.description: An industrial bioprocess thermal plant. Draws 1,000 kW of heat from the cells under organoid racks within 12 tiles, holding them at 37 °C.

flavor.quote: When we try to pick out anything by itself, we find it hitched to everything else in the universe.
flavor.author: John Muir
flavor.source: My First Summer in the Sierra, 1911

nutrient_works.name: Nutrient Works NW-60
nutrient_works.description: Fermentation-scale media production. Supplies 60 units a tick to its pipe net, at $2 a unit, for 60 kW of pumping.

flavor.quote: If you wish to make an apple pie from scratch, you must first invent the universe.
flavor.author: Carl Sagan

biogas_digester.name: Biogas Digester BG-2000
biogas_digester.description: An anaerobic digestion plant, a domed tank with a flare stub. Burns 50 units of nutrient medium a tick for up to 2,000 kW, and leaks 0.006 contamination a tick into each tile it stands on.

flavor.quote: We may lay it down as an incontestible axiom, that, in all the operations of art and nature, nothing is created;
flavor.author: Antoine Lavoisier

rack_neuromorphic2.name: NM-2 Event-Driven Array
rack_neuromorphic2.description: A mesh of spiking arrays that draw almost nothing for sparse work: 150 PFLOPS from 28 kW of air-cooled load, 5.4 PFLOPS per kW. Rung 2 of The Garden: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: I do not see why it should not enter any one of the fields normally covered by the human intellect
flavor.author: Alan Turing

rack_photonic2.name: PH-2 Photonic Mesh
rack_photonic2.description: A chip-to-chip optical fabric behind glass: 600 PFLOPS from 70 kW of air-cooled load, 8.6 PFLOPS per kW, the best in the game. Three tiles wide and the lowest PFLOPS per tile of the trees. Rung 4 of The Garden: you get it by retrofitting a rack, and it scores only for that tree.

flavor.quote: Nature isn't classical, dammit, and if you want to make a simulation of nature, you'd better make it quantum mechanical
flavor.author: Richard Feynman
flavor.source: Simulating Physics with Computers, International Journal of Theoretical Physics, 1982

crah_econ.name: OA-400 Outside-Air Economizer
crah_econ.description: A louvred roof box that brings cool outside air in. Removes up to 400 kW within 6 tiles at 18 °C outside or colder, falling to 40% at 27 °C. Free cooling when the weather helps, almost none when it does not.

flavor.quote: Nature, to be commanded, must be obeyed.
flavor.author: Francis Bacon

crah_adiabatic.name: AD-1500 Adiabatic Unit
crah_adiabatic.description: An evaporative air handler with a wet pad: 1,500 kW of heat removal within 10 tiles for 20 kW of fans. It drinks water and is happiest in dry air.

flavor.quote: There is at present in the material world a universal tendency to the dissipation of mechanical energy.
flavor.author: Lord Kelvin
flavor.source: On a Universal Tendency in Nature to the Dissipation of Mechanical Energy, 1852

fuel_cell.name: Hydrogen Fuel-Cell FC-1000
fuel_cell.description: A pale cabinet over a bank of hydrogen cylinders: 1,000 kW at $30 a kWh, in about 4 minutes. Clean, quiet and ruinously dear; it exists to replace the diesel for the dry weeks.

flavor.quote: I believe that water will one day be employed as fuel
flavor.author: Jules Verne

ups_iron_air.name: Iron-Air Store IA-20
ups_iron_air.description: A long rust-orange container of iron-air cells: 20,000 kWh at up to 1,500 kW, about 100 hours of backup for a small hall, at 50% round-trip efficiency.

flavor.quote: It is always darkest just before the day dawneth.
flavor.author: Thomas Fuller

geothermal.name: Geothermal Well GW-2000
geothermal.description: An enhanced-geothermal wellhead in the basement, hot pipes and a pump: 2,000 kW of firm power at $2 a kWh. Needs a basement floor, and never needs the weather.

flavor.quote: We find no vestige of a beginning,—no prospect of an end.
flavor.author: James Hutton

grid_tie_lucy.name: Luci's Rate Card
grid_tie_lucy.description: A 9 MW grid intake at a quarter off, negotiated by Luci herself in crimson and gold. Same capacity as the Grid Intake 9 MW for $1.1M. The catch is on the other page.

flavor.quote: A man who knows the price of everything and the value of nothing.
flavor.author: Oscar Wilde

microgrid_bea.name: Leaf-Bolt Microgrid
microgrid_bea.description: Bea's own block of 600 kW of photovoltaics on a cabinet with a leaf-bolt badge. Sun-dependent like any panel; the storage half of her design is still in the drawer.

flavor.quote: A thing is right when it tends to preserve the integrity, stability, and beauty of the biotic community.
flavor.author: Aldo Leopold

ice_store.name: Ice Thermal Battery
ice_store.description: An insulated white tank that freezes water at night and melts it at the peak. Draws 800 kW of heat from the air within 8 tiles. Cass built the first one herself.

flavor.quote: One must have a mind of winter
flavor.author: Wallace Stevens

cold_room.name: Cold Room
cold_room.description: A cold, quiet room with a heavy door. Cuts the failure rate of every rack within 8 tiles on its floor by 20%. It also pulls 60 kW of heat from the air there. Cass says it helps people think.

flavor.quote: After great pain, a formal feeling comes.
flavor.author: Emily Dickinson
